stages.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale
stages.description: Follow the chapter objectives in numerical order, then complete the final mission; IGN recommends early story progress to unlock equipment and systems, but its published walkthrough currently covers only Chapters 1–2. Take chapter-limited side jobs when they appear rather than postponing them to the next stage, and keep separate saves before major departures as a precaution. Known cutoffs are listed below; late-story trophy routes and chapter boundaries remain unverified, and no particular ending is prescribed.
pointsOfNoReturn: Chapter 1 — Donnie's goods drop-off becomes unavailable when Clear Skies begins; sell any intended haul beforehand.
Chapter 1 — finish Get Shirley's Rum, Find the Lost Drugs, and other Chapter 1-only jobs before starting Tourist Trap through Take Up Mattia's Offer.
Chapter 1 — Ring the Bell! has a narrower window: respond to Cal's message and visit the Rusty Anchor at the start of Swamped, before continuing to Brian's marina.
Chapter 2 — Key Lento is inaccessible during this chapter according to IGN; this is a regional restriction, not evidence that every unfinished trophy is lost.
Chapter 2 — Checking Out is the documented departure from the motel toward Vice City; a permanent optional-content cutoff at this mission is not verified.
Chapter 3 — no chapter-specific point of no return was established by the sources consulted; keep a separate save as a precaution.
Chapter 4 and finale — chapter boundaries, ending consequences, and permanent trophy lockouts were not documented in the consulted walkthrough.

stages.title: Stranger strands — finish the people stories
stages.description: Use this as a suggested cleanup pass for eight stranger strands and the final assignments for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone, not as a claim that all can safely be deferred. IGN says most optional missions remain available beyond their introductory chapter, while a few have restricted windows, so the Chapter 1 exceptions belong in your first-stage playthrough. Check messages and nearby conversations for leads; the full qualifying strand list and these characters' final-mission routes were not documented in the sources consulted.
pointsOfNoReturn: Do not defer Chapter 1-only optional jobs to this cleanup stage; see the first stage's Tourist Trap and Swamped warnings.
Kenton is unavailable as an NPC during Chapter 2 according to IGN; the consulted sources do not establish a permanent lockout for his final-mission trophy.

stages.title: Activities — victories, skills, and getaways
stages.description: Group race wins, drone locations, Cal's fishing challenge, arcade completion, 250 stunts, and gold medals across the Shooting Range challenges into a dedicated activity pass. Add hunting, combat, and robbery attempts as their systems become available; this grouping is a planning recommendation rather than a required unlock sequence. Record trophy victories separately from 100% targets, and leave ambiguous VCIA or Rhino triggers marked unverified instead of assuming a speculative method is complete.

stages.title: Collectibles and counts — sweep Leonida
stages.description: Plan regional sweeps for three complete card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicle discoveries, every meditation spot, and 50 Challenges, combining travel with exploration and garage or vehicle-registration work. Use collection checklists to avoid duplicates, and keep trophy totals distinct from the larger targets listed for 100% completion. This is a suggested way to reduce repeated trips; the sources do not establish a universal post-story availability guarantee, and the exact Scooter Bros registration flow remains unverified.

stages.title: Cleanup and platinum — A Long Road to legend
stages.description: After the story, inspect Progress → Stats → 100% Completion and resolve each unfinished category for A Long Road, including requirements that exceed standalone trophy counts. Finish remaining spending, laundering, and clue-based trophies, keeping undocumented triggers explicitly unresolved rather than treating guesses as solutions. Vice Got a Price! follows only when all other 54 trophies are earned, so complete both the 100% statistic and the remaining individual awards.
pointsOfNoReturn: A Long Road depends on optional missions according to IGN, including Chapter 1-only jobs: preserve those opportunities during the first stage rather than discovering the gap during final cleanup.
The consulted completion guide is still being updated and has some conflicting totals; use the game's own category targets to resolve discrepancies.
